verdict.rationale: Poke's own release notes say it can create tables and charts from described data or from images of spreadsheets, which covers the chart-output part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the assistant writing or running code on user data, producing computed answers, or returning downloadable files. Missing for 10: documented code execution/sandbox, computed analysis on uploaded data files, downloadable file outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration of charting.
